items.name: Potion of Cure Light Wounds
items.description:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 1st

Spell Description
When laying your hand upon a living creature, you channel positive energy that cures 1d8 points of damage +1 point per caster level (maximum +5). Since undead are powered by negative energy, this spell deals damage to them instead of curing their wounds. An undead creature can apply Spell Resistance, and can attempt a Will save to take half damage.

items.name: Steelchew
items.description: Temporarily changes all the users soft tissue to hardened steel. This results in an Ironskin spell (+6 natural armor), DR10 vs Slashing, and blindness. lasts 2d6 minutes.

items.name: Life Giving Amulet
items.description:
Once per day when the wearer of this amulet is reduced to 0hp or lower, an @Compendium[pf1.spells.ny2qxht2aeesoi08]{Infernal Healing, Greater} spell is cast upon them immediately. 

 

If the wearer is instantly killed by HP damage (reduced to CON below zero), the amulet shatters and casts @Compendium[pf1.spells.qiiis9ekgy3syu7j]{Breath of Life} on them.

items.name: Deer Shit
items.description: Grants Expeditious Retreat buff for 4d4 minutes. Leaves a bad taste in the mouth.

items.name: Potion of Air Bubble
items.description:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 1st

Air bubble creates a small pocket of breathable air that surrounds the touched creature's head or the touched object. The air bubble allows the creature touched to breathe underwater or in similar airless environments, or protects the object touched from water damage.
